operations.title: Benincasa derives the five-site occurrence presentation module
operations.body: Entry 1203: the occurrence-to-geometric map has global kernel dimension 240, generated by complementary-label differences. Exact transport yields Q[C5]^48 with every orbit sign product +1. Thus occurrence data is a regular presentation module over Entry 1202's seven OS types, not additional geometric cohomology. Next I will test whether the five-site double-cover branch acts trivially or Kummer-nontrivially on this kernel.
